### tracing surface of section

I have two scans where I search periodic orbits and look random trajectories, in order to see how the structures change for the various energy shells between $E_1=-0.5$ and $E_2=-0.3$.
This region is particular interesting, as this region is where the structure of phasespac change from partially structured system to a completly chaotic system.

![](../../figures/two-boxed-charges/periodic_orbits/scan2/po_E-0.5_C-1_del1e-08_L1-1_N3.png)

![](../../figures/two-boxed-charges/periodic_orbits/scan2/po_E-0.3008_C-1_del1e-08_L1-1_N3.png)


A particular interesting region, is the energy range: $E=-0.45765\frac{\mathcal{C}}{L}$ and $E=-0.43882 \frac{\mathcal{C}}{L}$.


![](../../figures/two-boxed-charges/periodic_orbits/scan2/po_E-0.4325_C-1_del1e-08_L1-1_N3.png)

![](../../figures/two-boxed-charges/periodic_orbits/scan2/po_E-0.4137_C-1_del1e-08_L1-1_N3.png)

![](../../figures/two-boxed-charges/periodic_orbits/scan2/po_E-0.3878_C-1_del1e-08_L1-1_N3.png)

![](../../figures/two-boxed-charges/periodic_orbits/scan2/po_E-0.3659_C-1_del1e-08_L1-1_N3.png)


I also tested this transition for various gap sizes, though the simulation for $del=10^{-3}, 10^{-5}, 10^{-8}$ still crashes for the chaotic region.
Interestingly the qualitatively, the region inspected ($E\in[-0.5,-0.3]$) seems qualitatively unaffected.
